event.title: FDA approval of midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for PTSD
event.proposition: The FDA approves midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for post-traumatic stress disorder.
event.criterion: TRUE on the date the FDA approval letter or Drugs@FDA entry (or the sponsor's approval announcement) for midomafetamine for PTSD is dated, on any review cycle. A complete response letter, a positive advisory vote or a filing acceptance is not an approval. A label narrower than PTSD (for example a PTSD subgroup) counts if the claim's indication reasonably includes it and the reading is logged at intake.
readings: Approval under any sponsor name (Lykos Therapeutics, MAPS PBC or a successor) counts; the entry is on the asset.
This is eventual approval on any cycle, distinct from the first-cycle approval event proposed for the 2024 PDUFA date (new:fda-midomafetamine-ptsd-first-cycle-approval).

event.criterion: TRUE on the date S.1717, or another bill that carries the operative text of S.1717 (a Medicare coverage pathway for FDA breakthrough-designated products), is signed into law or otherwise becomes law, as recorded on Congress.gov. records.stage_note: S.1717 was an introduced Senate bill of the 119th Congress at the statement date. No class in base-rates.json covers enactment of a bill, so b is null and the reference row abstains.
